options.content:
Fleet operations at a glance. Read left to right: cluster readiness, active incidents, service history, capacity and telemetry delivery. Green means an observed healthy signal, not guaranteed total coverage. N/A means missing evidence. Use the links for focused diagnostics.

Green, amber and red indicate explicit status. Blue is quantitative emphasis. N/A means missing or unsupported data, never healthy zero.
